name: Novels ~Game Center Arashi R~
original_name: ノベルズ ～ゲームセンターあらしＲ～
source:
The story is about a young boy named Arashi Ishino who is obsessed with video games. He would spend all his time trying to beat the games and conquer the local arcades. He would meet competitors like Satoru Daimonji and Ishii, who would try to out match him with higher scores. At a certain point in each episode, he would display his special skill of unleashing a top which will spin so fast that both the top and his hands would catch on fire. On release, the spin would land on or near the cabinet panels, turning the ordinary button into a turbo button thus giving him a major advantage. His appearance is known for being bucktoothed, and he always wears a hat labeled "Arashi" with a picture of a sprited alien.

Novels - Game Center Arashi R is a sound novel game that features 5 different stories, 4 of them are playable at the beginning of the game, the game features different endings in each story depending of the player choices during the game, and a point system for the player.

[From [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/N/SLPS-02009.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了一个名叫石野岚的小男孩痴迷于电子游戏的故事。他将所有的时间都花在试图打败游戏并征服当地的游乐场上。他会遇到像大文字悟和石井这样的竞争对手，他们会试图以更高的分数超越他。在每一集的某个时刻，他都会展示他的特殊技能，释放一个陀螺，陀螺旋转得如此之快，陀螺和他的手都会着火。释放时，旋转将落在机柜面板上或附近，将普通按钮变成涡轮按钮，从而给他带来重大优势。他的外表以龅牙而闻名，他总是戴着一顶标有“Arashi”的帽子，上面有一个精灵外星人的照片。

小说 - Game Center Arashi R是一款声音小说游戏，具有5个不同的故事，其中4个故事可以在游戏开始时玩，游戏根据玩家在游戏中的选择而在每个故事中提供不同的结局，并为玩家提供积分系统。
